cards.title: 身份生命周期
cards.owner_role: F02 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 首次权限、注册登录、忘记密码、重登；错误凭据拒绝且不污染已登录身份

cards.title: 好友关系
cards.owner_role: F02 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 申请接受拒绝撤回、备注标签、删除拉黑；双方关系与访问限制一致

cards.title: 发送与媒体
cards.owner_role: F03 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 两方向文本/长文/表情/图片/视频/语音/文件/位置；message_id关联UI与持久化

cards.title: 消息操作
cards.owner_role: F03 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 引用转发复制收藏删除撤回搜索；操作后双方权限与内容符合策略

cards.title: 会话与恢复
cards.owner_role: F03 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 未读置顶免打扰草稿分页、离线重连重启；无重复消息且历史可读

cards.title: 通知与深链
cards.owner_role: F03 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 前后台/杀进程通知、权限拒绝、点击定位；不泄露E2EE内容且不串号

cards.title: 建群与准入
cards.owner_role: F04 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 普通公开私密群、邀请申请二维码；非成员越权失败

cards.title: 角色与治理
cards.owner_role: F04 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 名称头像公告禁言管理员转让举报；逐角色正反权限一致

cards.title: 成员退出与解散
cards.owner_role: F04 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 加踢退出重入解散；新旧成员消息访问及历史授权正确

cards.title: 群消息
cards.owner_role: F04 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 双向消息全类型与操作、离线历史；群外身份不可读取

cards.title: 群文件相册
cards.owner_role: F05 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 上传下载预览删除；跨成员可见、撤权拒绝、归属不串群

cards.title: 群任务
cards.owner_role: F05 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 创建分配修改状态与详情；授权成员状态同步、非法角色失败

cards.title: 群投票
cards.owner_role: F05 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 创建参与重复提交截止结果；计票唯一且过期拒绝

cards.title: 群日程分类
cards.owner_role: F05 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 日程编辑参与提醒取消、分类标签全部入口；重进持久化

cards.title: 发布与媒体
cards.owner_role: F06 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 文图视频发布失败重试、编辑能力或明确不支持、删除分页；服务端内容与UI一致

cards.title: 互动与隐私
cards.owner_role: F06 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 赞取消、评论回复删除、@、通知、屏蔽可见范围；非授权第三人实际请求失败

cards.title: 频道创建发现
cards.owner_role: F07 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 公开私密付费、资料修改、发现筛选搜索；展示和准入策略一致

cards.title: 订阅与治理
cards.owner_role: F07 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 订阅退订邀请审批管理员；撤权后刷新与读取被拒绝

cards.title: 内容与评论
cards.owner_role: F07 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 发布全部支持类型、详情评论治理；双端传播、删除及分页一致

cards.title: 个人资料二维码
cards.owner_role: F08 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 头像昵称性别地区、二维码；重登回读一致且无跨账号残留

cards.title: 收藏与黑名单
cards.owner_role: F08 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 收藏详情分类删除、黑名单移除；源内容撤权后不能绕过访问

cards.title: 设置与显示
cards.owner_role: F08 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 语言主题字号缓存存储、关于升级；重启保持选择且清理不破坏密钥

cards.title: 安全与设备
cards.owner_role: F08 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 密码绑定设备踢出、备份恢复入口；错误恢复不覆盖现有状态、撤权会话拒绝

cards.title: 反馈与注销
cards.owner_role: F08 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 反馈详情、注销合成账号；确认取消不删数据、确认后权限和本地数据清除

cards.title: 组织生命周期
cards.owner_role: F09 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 创建邀请申请审批拒绝撤回退出解散；角色移交与末位owner限制

cards.title: 成员部门
cards.owner_role: F09 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 部门成员增删改分页搜索停用恢复；跨组织非法写入失败

cards.title: 图形组织架构
cards.owner_role: F09 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 成员切换、缩放拖动fit、103根深树节点连线；403清图、晚到响应不串组织

cards.title: 工作区切换
cards.owner_role: F10 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 默认与新建加入退出、成员品牌；个人/企业切换、空工作台始终可见

cards.title: 项目协作
cards.owner_role: F10 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 项目成员频道任务里程碑洞察所有子页；权限与状态跨端一致

cards.title: 企业群频道
cards.owner_role: F11 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 企业准入、群与频道归属、退企撤权；orgB第三身份不可读取orgA

cards.title: 企业资料
cards.owner_role: F11 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 文档上传移动下载删除、历史附件；对象归属与新授权校验一致

cards.title: 坐席入口队列
cards.owner_role: F12 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 角色入口上线下线、两坐席并发接单；仅一个持久化胜者

cards.title: 服务会话
cards.owner_role: F12 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 真实Widget访客到坐席、附件转接结束历史；访客/坐席/主管权限正确

cards.title: 后台业务治理
cards.owner_role: F12 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 组织部门成员群频道资料管理、筛选分页审计；App消费治理结果正确

cards.title: 双人通话
cards.owner_role: F13 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 呼叫接听拒绝取消忙线挂断权限切换；真实双向声音画面、重连

cards.title: 群通话直播
cards.owner_role: F13 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 多参与者入离房主持权限、直播全入口；人数媒体一致，端点不足BLOCKED

cards.title: 中继异常
cards.owner_role: F13 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: relay-only双向媒体、断网恢复/权限拒绝；同session TURN与RTP及客户端日志关联

cards.title: 搜索扫码导航
cards.owner_role: F14 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 全局消息网页搜索、扫码分流登录；目标与身份正确、非法链接拒绝

cards.title: 资金与付费
cards.owner_role: F14 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: 钱包红包转账本地订单付费频道；重复请求不重扣、订单与订阅一致，不触真实资金

cards.title: AI位置剩余入口
cards.owner_role: F14 domain worker (assign exact identity before READY)
cards.behavior_and_oracle: AI/bot定位附近外链及全部剩余页面；策略拒绝/服务失败可恢复、无隐式明文降级
